newsitem.title: UK: Northern repeats plea for UK to join EMU.
newsitem.headline: Northern repeats plea for UK to join EMU.

text.p: Sir Christopher Haskins, chairman of British food producer Northern Foods, called on Britain to join a single European currency.

"If there is one company that thinks EMU is a good idea it is us," Haskins told reporters, after the company reported half year profits impacted by the strength of sterling against other European currencies.
He said EMU would help remove fluctuations in its profits, overstated last year because of sterling's weakness in Europe and then understated this year.
In September Northern was among a group of 15 top British companies that warned in a letter to the Financial Times newspaper of the dangers of Britain shunning a single European currency.
